title: 第2570章 认错人了第2569章 灵石矿脉
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
“况且，你的实力目前只是地球无敌，万一以后遇到有像我这种降临到地球的强者，你可对付不了，必须要接着提升实力，你为了你自己，也要为了你现在的家人啊。”
丘凌风如此说到。
“也是，那就麻烦你了。”
千星阁阁主闻言，沉思片刻，点了点头。
“你这有修炼的地方么？我给你传授《魂源星易功》，这就是那个可以让人星瞬的功法，不用担心灵气问题。”
丘凌风站起身来，拍了拍千星阁阁主的肩膀。
“自然是有。”
千星阁阁主点了点头。
随后，千星阁阁主就带着丘凌风来到了练功房。
练功房里空间宽敞，四周也摆满了各种锻炼器材。
丘凌风看了一眼空地，挥手一撒，成堆的上品灵石在四周堆叠。
同时聚灵阵法布下，确保灵气不会外泄。
接着，丘凌风深吸了一口气，凝聚星辰之力。
“《魂源星易功》是极品功法，需要进行传承领悟，能悟多少，全凭你自己。”
“此为安魂通明丹，服下后可以增强你的思维感知，提升悟性。”
“此为星辰灵丹，服下后可以激发星辰之力，助长你的领悟速度。”
丘凌风说完，又给千星阁阁主递过去了两瓶丹药。
紧接着，星天界覆盖住了整个练功房。
星天殿于星天界内浮现而出。
“进里面去参悟吧。”

丘凌风指着星天殿的入口，朝着千星阁阁主说道。
“多谢。”
千星阁阁主十分喜欢这个修炼环境，朝着丘凌风抱了抱拳，便进入了星天殿中。
丘凌风随即退出练功房。
千星阁阁主能领悟多少，全凭他自己的悟性。
不过他相信自己的悟性不会差到哪里去。
再怎么说，千星阁阁主也是能够在地球这种灵气匮乏的地方修炼到神域境巅峰的存在呀！
……
下午五点半。
丘凌风正坐在客厅，和季攸竹、沐诗瑶、白彩彩三人聊天。
毕竟对于这个异时空的丘凌风，她们实在是太好奇了。
咔哒。
大门在此刻突然打开，一道身影风风火火的从外面跑了进来。
“老公，我回来惹~~”
一进门，那身影就锁定了丘凌风，直接一个飞扑，抱住了沙发上的丘凌风。
丘凌风瞪大眼睛，立即举起双手，以证清白。
“诶诶诶？！姑娘，你干啥呢？男女授受不亲啊！”
丘凌风惊慌失措的喊道。
“老公，怎么一个多月不见，你头发这么长了，还是说戴着假发？而且你说话怎么这么奇怪啊？这又是在玩什么新花样？”
抱着丘凌风的那道倩影在库库吸了几口丘凌风身上的气味后，就抬起头，一脸疑惑的看着丘凌风。
content_en:
"Besides, your strength is currently only invincible on Earth. If you encounter a strong person like me who comes to Earth in the future, you won't be able to deal with it. You must continue to improve your strength. You have to do it for yourself and your current family."
Qiu Lingfeng said this.
"Yes, then I'll trouble you."
Upon hearing this, the Pavilion Master of Qianxing Pavilion pondered for a moment and nodded.
"Do you have a place to practice here? I will teach you the "Soul Source Star Yi Gong". This is the technique that can make people star instantly. You don't have to worry about spiritual energy problems."
Qiu Lingfeng stood up and patted the master of Qianxing Pavilion on the shoulder.
"Of course there is."
The master of Qianxing Pavilion nodded.
Later, the master of Qianxing Pavilion brought Qiu Lingfeng to the practice room.
The practice room is spacious and surrounded by various exercise equipment.
Qiu Lingfeng glanced at the open space, waved his hand, and piles of high-grade spiritual stones were piled around.
At the same time, the spirit gathering formation was set up to ensure that the spiritual energy would not leak out.
Then, Qiu Lingfeng took a deep breath and gathered the power of the stars.
"The "Soul Source Star Yi Gong" is a top-notch technique that needs to be passed down and understood. How much you can understand is entirely up to you."
"This is the Requiem and Brightness Pill. After taking it, it can enhance your thinking perception and improve your understanding."
"This is the star elixir. After taking it, it can stimulate the power of the stars and increase your speed of understanding."
After Qiu Lingfeng finished speaking, he handed over two bottles of pills to the master of Qianxing Pavilion.
Immediately afterwards, the star world covered the entire practice room.
The Starry Sky Palace emerged within the Starry Sky Realm.
"Go inside and gain enlightenment."
Qiu Lingfeng pointed to the entrance of Xingtian Palace and said to the master of Qianxing Pavilion.
"Thank you."
The master of Qianxing Pavilion liked this training environment very much. He hugged Qiu Lingfeng and entered the Xingtian Palace.
Qiu Lingfeng immediately exited the practice room.
How much the Qianxing Pavilion Pavilion Master can comprehend depends entirely on his own understanding.
However, he believed that his understanding would not be much worse.
No matter what, the Pavilion Master of Qianxing Pavilion is someone who can cultivate to the peak of the divine realm in a place like Earth where spiritual energy is lacking!
…
Half past five in the afternoon.
Qiu Lingfeng was sitting in the living room, chatting with Ji Youzhu, Mu Shiyao and Bai Caicai.
After all, they were really curious about this Qiu Lingfeng from another time and space.
Click.
The door suddenly opened at this moment, and a figure ran in from the outside.
“Husband, I’ll come back to mess with you~~”
As soon as he entered the door, the figure locked on Qiu Lingfeng, swooped down and hugged Qiu Lingfeng on the sofa.
Qiu Lingfeng's eyes widened and he immediately raised his hands to prove his innocence.
"Hey?! Girl, what are you doing? Men and women don't have sex!"
Qiu Lingfeng shouted in panic.
"Hubby, why haven't we seen each other for more than a month? Your hair is so long, or are you wearing a wig? And why do you speak so strangely? What new trick are you playing?"
The beautiful figure holding Qiu Lingfeng raised her head and looked at Qiu Lingfeng with a puzzled expression after taking a few breaths of Qiu Lingfeng's scent in Kuku.
